source: Explicit user instruction: choose Route 2, regular Flygon family with existing Mega plus a separate Bug/Ground Delta Flygon family, and erase the Electric/Dragon line from the proposed game roster.

ordinaryMega.name: Mega Flygon

artworkCandidate.evidence: 2026-10-23 recovered DS export approve; one implementation slot only

ordinaryMega.alternativeArtworkNote: Separate Mega_Flygon Design 2 has older historical approval but an unverified matching back sprite, and is not an additional Mega form

deltaFamily.lineTheme: Bug-typed first two stages evolving into Bug/Ground Delta Flygon
deltaFamily.earlierStageTypes: Delta Trapinch and Delta Vibrava must each include Bug as one of their types (either monotype Bug or Bug paired with another existing type). The other type, if any, is open until artwork and biology are selected; they do NOT each have to be Bug/Ground.
requiredBeforeIntegration: Exact source-specific user selection of Delta Trapinch, Delta Vibrava and Delta Flygon designs
Verified front/back/shiny/icon consistency, name, type and evolution family
DS 4bpp and native archive rendering tests
Species/form ID collision audit and reproducible Platinum ROM tests
searchCriteria: A coherent independently redesigned three-stage family rather than color-only variants
Find already-made art first; prefer complete, matching front/back/shiny/icon sprite sets
No auto-approval or importing earlier rejected designs

excludedFromPlannedRoster.reason: User abandoned formerly selected Electric/Dragon alternate line
Do not retain Electric/Dragon alternate Mega when the alternate line is retired

legacyDraftMapOverride: Treat Flygon Redux-to-Delta entries in the old bulk map as superseded for this family. Do not auto-import SPECIES_FLYGON_REDUX, SPECIES_FLYGON_REDUX_MEGA, SPECIES_TRAPINCH_REDUX or SPECIES_VIBRAVA_REDUX.
